prices.rule: Demo prices, not real prices. h = first 8 hex digits of sha256(product code) as an integer; days = units_per_container / (units_per_serving * servings_per_day); Demo Store price = 4.00 + 0.08 * days + 0.25 * mapped nutrients + (h mod 200) / 100 USD, rounded half up to cents, always in stock; Demo Market is listed when h mod 3 != 0, at the Demo Store price times (1 + ((h div 256) mod 15) / 100), rounded half up to cents, out of stock when (h div 65536) mod 7 == 0; checked_at is midnight UTC of the day the label was retrieved.

VIT_B6: 2 rows in mg summed to 12.5
